Thus sequence:

mkdir Reports
find . -name summary.doc -> capture path
if found, mv <found_path> Reports/
grep data.txt "Q4 financials" -> show matches
wc data.txt l -> give line count

Let's produce responses accordingly. We'll execute each tool sequentially.
